description: This file defines a Redux store enhancer for persisting specific parts of the SQL Lab state to local storage, including logic for filtering and merging persisted data, with feature flag checks and size calculation.

methods.name: slicer
methods.description: A function that filters and prepares parts of the SQL Lab state for persistence based on feature flags and current state.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: A function that merges persisted state with the initial Redux state, ensuring correct overwriting of specific parts.
